build_encoder_vae: build a VAE Encoder that converts input images into latent representations with configurable down blocks
build_decoder_vae: build a VAE Decoder that reconstructs images from latent representations with configurable up blocks
build_vector_quantizer: build a VectorQuantizer that maps continuous latents to discrete codebook embeddings with remapping support
build_diagonal_gaussian_distribution: build a DiagonalGaussianDistribution to sample latents from mean and log-variance parameters for VAE models
build_encoder_tiny: build an EncoderTiny lightweight encoder using AutoencoderTinyBlock layers for fast latent encoding
